Purpose and exclusions

Choose resources randomly from intentionally authored eligible sites, not arbitrary map coordinates. Server selection respects biome, surface, navigation, collision, roads, quotas and active/depleted generations, and can be reproduced from recorded zone seed/cycle.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Create DT_ResourceSites_Rillmere with OreSite_A01, OreSite_A02, TreeSite_W03 and an intentionally invalid road site. Store transforms in cm and surface/biome tags.
  2. Create DA_ResourceRule_Rillmere with separate ore/tree quotas, rarity selection and spacing. Add BP_ResourceDirector once per zone with server-only authority.
  3. Place simple graybox rock/tree meshes authored or separately licensed by the developer; no such meshes are claimed to be in the sprite ZIP.
  4. Add footprint overlap checks and navigation/ground trace validation. Export validation diagnostics with exact rejected site ID and reason.
  5. Reopen zone startup readiness: resource interactions remain disabled until state reconciliation finishes. Reopen node replication settings to notify late joiners of correct depleted state.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Project custom contracts are not engine/plugin nodes. A read-only asset participates through its consumer; it does not inherit that consumer’s mutation methods. Backend endpoint pages label transport proposals explicitly.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Construct with only safe defaults; no service calls or world scans from construction scripts.
  2. Inject current owner/definition/session and subscribe once after readiness. Possession and replicated state may arrive in either order; guard initialization.
  3. Accept only permitted commands under current identity/epoch; keep local UI/cosmetic prediction separate from committed state.
  4. After server/backend result apply only matching request generation and nonstale revision; late reply to old body does not mutate new body.
  5. On death, transfer, disconnect, restart or teardown cancel transient work, clear input/timers, unbind delegates and release weak observers. Durable receipts remain authoritative.
  6. On reconnect create fresh runtime objects from current committed snapshot; never deserialize old Actor/widget pointers or rerun initial grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Biome resource sites, random placement and respawn. Rule owner: URPGResourceDirector. This asset’s role is Choose resources randomly from intentionally authored eligible sites, not arbitrary map coordinates. Server selection respects biome, surface, navigation, collision, roads, quotas and active/depleted generations, and can be reproduced from recorded zone seed/cycle.

  1. Content author marks candidate sites and resource tags; an Editor validator rejects duplicate IDs, unreachable positions and invalid footprint/road intersections.
  2. On server zone startup, load durable site generations/depletion first, then choose eligible inactive candidates using the recorded seed/cycle and quotas.
  3. Project/sweep the candidate to the intended surface, verify slope/clearance and reserve spacing; do not project to a bridge below/above accidentally without surface identity.
  4. Spawn only approved active nodes; replicate nearby node type/generation/availability, with dormancy for unchanged nodes and explicit wake-up on depletion/respawn.
  5. Gather completion transaction changes durable node generation state alongside reward. Director consumes the committed result and schedules respawn.
  6. On restart, reconstruct depleted nodes/timers from backend and catch up bounded due respawns; never refill every site because the Actor was recreated.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_Rillmere / OreSite_A01 / TreeSite_W03 / InvalidSite_Road. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Candidate sits in road, steep cliff or blocking prop -> PlacementRejected with no node.
Two directors accidentally configured -> duplicate zone owner validation fails; do not double quotas.
Server restart after depletion -> same depleted generation and due time, not a fresh grant.
Seed/cycle replay against same catalog -> same selected site set; catalog changes require new version/audit.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not duplicate a native rule in Blueprint, assume a planned type is compiled, or keep callbacks/owners valid after world or session replacement.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
